feed.title: Google Cloud: Error Reporting
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Error Reporting

entry.content:
Error Reporting can report stack traces collected from Rust applications using std::backtrace. To enable, set the RUST_BACKTRACE=1 environment variable and make sure debug symbols are enabled.

For more information, see ReportedErrorEvent.
entry.summary: Error Reporting now supports stack traces from Rust applications using std::backtrace. Enable this feature by setting the RUST_BACKTRACE=1 environment variable and ensuring debug symbols are included in your build. This allows for more detailed debugging of errors originating from Rust code.
entry.title: Announcement: Rust Error Reporting with Backtraces

entry.content: You can view the available regional endpoints for the Error Reporting API on the REST reference pages. For an example, see Method: projects.events.list.
entry.summary: You can find the regional endpoints for the Error Reporting API on the REST reference pages. For example, check the projects.events.list method documentation.
entry.title: Announcement: View Regional Endpoints for Error Reporting API

entry.content: You can use the Error Reporting API MCP server to let agents and AI applications interact with your error data. This feature is in Preview.
entry.summary: Interact with your error data using the new Error Reporting API. This feature is currently in Preview.
